original.statement: In 0.46.0 the Kafka Connect configuration is moved into the ConfigMap created by the operator, changing how that configuration is delivered to Kafka Connect.

decision.reason: [ev-12b17c85ab22] says only that Kafka Connect configuration now lives in the ConfigMap the operator creates. The change concerns how the operator delivers configuration to Kafka Connect, so it reaches every environment that deploys Kafka Connect through the KafkaConnect custom resource. The evidence names no narrower condition, such as a particular field or setting, so gvk-in-use for kafka.strimzi.io KafkaConnect is the closest match. Confidence is low because this single changelog line does not say whether other Connect-based resources are also affected.
